name: B10-0328/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks the United Arab Emirates to free Ryan Cornelius, a British businessman held in Dubai since 2008, and all other people held arbitrarily. It also asks the United Arab Emirates to join two international human rights treaties, and asks the European Commission to check the human rights impact before agreeing a partnership deal with the country.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Ryan Cornelius, other detainees in the United Arab Emirates, and future European Union talks with the country.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the United Arab Emirates government, the European Commission and other bodies.
